name: Darkness
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Choose a point or small object within short range. Magical darkness emanates out from it to short range. If you chose an object, the darkness moves with the object.

Mundane light and natural vision do not pierce the darkness. Only light or sight granted by a spell with a greater XP cost than this one can penetrate the darkness.

Uncheck any number of Conditions. For each Condition you uncheck (twice for Afraid), choose one:

  • +Range to the darkness' radius (maximum of long range).

  • The darkness is also deathly cold. Creatures that enter or begin their turn in the darkness take 1d4+HEART damage.

  • You can see through the darkness as if it weren't there (though you can see a faint outline of its edges).

  • You may maintain the spell for up to 10 minutes.
